sources.title: Karma Phuntsho, The History of Bhutan

sources.note: Government and UNICEF assessment checked for current child vulnerability to air, water, toxic substances, and climate hazards.

sources.title: Journal of Bhutan Studies 18, traditional medicine and bioprospecting

proposedOverrides.name: Medieval Bhutan region
proposedOverrides.summary: Approximate and badly displaced 1200 to 1279 atlas layer for the region now called Bhutan, best read as cultural geography amid Buddhist networks and local authorities rather than a unified medieval state.
